nodes.label: Everest July 2026 Premium Lifestyle Content Plan
nodes.rationale: Feed must feel premium and lifestyle-led (show where the cars take you, not the price box); July = Mpumalanga mid-winter dry season (Kruger, Panorama Route, school holidays); warm editorial grade, headline restraint, yellow accent as a whisper; runs through the six-template system (lifestyle_hero, studio, spec_card, multi_car, tip_card, sell_yours).
